original_test_intent: Verify all expected UPPER_FAN1 through UPPER_FAN5 R-position resources in BMC Web, including physical assembly/pair, RPM, units, health, thresholds, freshness and range against the approved cooling SPEC.
original_method: Resolve vendor F/R semantics and fan population; enumerate five explicit R members in the protected UI; bind each to its upper chassis assembly and F partner; capture page context; compare complete fields to the SPEC; optionally correlate full backend data; preserve logs and make no fan-policy changes.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer resolves R-position semantics, confirms the five physical R-to-F pair mappings and validates all rendered fields against the cooling SPEC.
safety_requirements: Do not change fan duty/curves, cooling, power or firmware
agent_execution_scope: Map each to upper assembly and F partner
Compare RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range
engineer_actions: Approve F/R semantics and pair map

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The literal `UPPER_FAN1~5_R` query does not enumerate five resources; truncated SDR and motherboard-PSU temperature output cannot prove this case.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture five explicit R UI members and their F-pair mappings; use full exact-name backend reads only as approved corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Web/SPEC inspection and 3/3-minute estimate remain; generic clear and MB PSU substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every numbered R resource to its physical upper assembly and corresponding F channel, then assess complete fresh speed/status evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds suffix semantics and paired-rotor topology.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A healthy F member cannot compensate for a missing or mis-mapped R tachometer in evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Expected F/R speed relation depends on platform control design; do not invent equality tolerance without the SPEC.

project_override_considerations: Define R meaning, five expected assemblies, F/R pair identities and any allowed paired-speed relationship. The prior F case and duplicate MB PSU temperature row remain independent.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/Web route and upper-fan topology with F/R definition
Protected UI captures for all R members and page context
Per-member assembly/F-pair, RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion consistently target upper R-position fans. Generic clear and MB PSU output are method/reference defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Suffix semantics, fan map, SPEC and UI are obtainable package inputs; execution becomes BLOCKED if R identities remain unresolved.

review_improvement: Ensures each R tachometer is assessed as its own mapped channel rather than inferred from the preceding F row or replaced by PSU temperature evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: In a paired fan cartridge, either rotor/tach channel can fail independently. A valid five-member R review must preserve the one-to-one R-to-assembly and R-to-F relationship; otherwise duplicated labels or evidence from the healthy partner can mask loss of redundancy.
